parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the dedicated block storage cluster resides. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs update-solution-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --solution-instance-id inst-000 --name defaultName --description defaultDescription --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ebs UpdateSolutionInstanceAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description defaultDescription --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SolutionInstanceId 'inst-000' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name defaultName
